parser_policy: Accept only one dyld marker at beginning of line, exact UUID syntax, absolute path with no embedded angle brackets/control chars; require candidate path is_file. Reject malformed/interleaved/split image records, with no reconstruction. Restrict records to PIDs observed loading exact candidate paths. System paths are lexical records; filesystem-verified and cache-only/unverified paths are separated. Only filesystem-verified candidate and system paths populate paths/dyld_records; syntactically matched unverified system paths and other corrupted fragments remain explicitly separate.
scope: Only supplied runtime log and launch JSON plus optional prior schema; file existence checks of parsed image paths. No UI, builds, tests, process queries/signals, child management, or production edits.
unknowns: Interleaved, truncated or corrupted DYLD records prevent a complete loaded-image dependency-closure claim.
PID membership is inferred from exact candidate-path DYLD records, not independently verified parent/child process topology.
Syntactically valid system paths without filesystem entries may be shared-cache images or malformed strings; not certified as complete valid images.
This is a snapshot of a live runtime log; later loads are not included.
